title: Blockchains, crypto, & web3: Connections, models, more

reader_summary.overview: blockchain, crypto, Web3, these terms get thrown around a lot and sometimes are used interchangeably, but what are the actual connections between them? And what are some mental models and analogies for thinking about this blossoming area of computer science? To dig in on these topics and more, we have another crossover episode this week.

thesis: The speakers argue that blockchains are autonomous computers where software governs hardware, enabling perpetual commitments like fixed supply that traditional centralized systems cannot guarantee. They further explain that decentralization is the mechanism allowing a representative community to collectively own and neutrally control these autonomous systems.
